objective: With distinct middle variables, classify the additional stage obstructions caused by hidden padding identities, their effect on the global projection, and whether sharing solely between stages matters.
status: Proved: With distinct middle names, each pad identity shared between the two branches adds exactly two local minimal contradictory guard supports. Global supports are products of one local support at each stage and the two endpoints, even if hidden pads are reused between stages.
title: Which shared padding values defeat independent implication collapse?
